red_flags.quote: Party B may sublet part or the whole of the Premises to another party during the tenancy (subject to the consent of Party A).

Party B shall return the Premises in a condition consistent with the Premises having been used normally. Party A shall inspect the Premises when the Premises are returned and the parties hereto shall settle the fees that they are respectively responsible for.
Party B may terminate the tenancy at its sole decision and/or require Party A to cover the losses suffered by it, and such termination shall not be regarded as breach of this Contract.
If the said liquidate damages are insufficient to make up for the losses suffered by the other party, the defaulting party shall further compensate for the balance thereof:
Party B may sublets the Premises, transfers the leasing right of the Premises or exchanges with a third party their respective leased Premises without permission.
